mechanics.claim: The initial cast and the manual recast are separate damage instances, and the initial cast and manual recast each count as ability activations for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: If the recast is not manually triggered, the explosion still happens automatically at max range but does not count as a separate ability activation.
mechanics.quote: If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield can block only one of the two damage instances (the active or the recast), not both if the first is blocked.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} can block the effects of either the active or the recast, but not both if the former is blocked.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown begins after the recast/explosion resolves, not on initial cast.
